\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{احتیاط} (ehtiyât)}{احتیاط (ehtiyât)}]{\fa{احتیاط} (ehtiyât) — caution, care}

\label{lesson:FA-C397-ehtiyat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to coordinate, then the Persian for to carry out.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{احتیاط}}
\textbf{\fa{احتیاط}} (\emph{ehtiyât}) — \textquotedblleft{}caution, care\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{با} \fa{احتیاط} \fa{از} \fa{پله} \fa{ها} \fa{پایین} \fa{رفت}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{u bâ ehtiyât az pelle hâ pâyin raft.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He went down the stairs with care.
\end{quote}

\emph{Bâ ehtiyât} — carefully. \emph{Ehtiyât kardan} — to be careful.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{احتیاط}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{iḥtiyāṭ} \textquotedblleft{}caution, precaution\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ehtiyât}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{ehtiyât}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to coordinate, then the Persian for to carry out, then say \emph{ehtiyât} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط} (mahz-e ehtiyât)}{محض احتیاط (mahz-e ehtiyât)}]{\fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط} (mahz-e ehtiyât) — as a precaution, in case}

\label{lesson:FA-C397-mahz-e-ehtiyat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to carry out, then the Persian for caution.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط}}
\textbf{\fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط}} (\emph{mahz-e ehtiyât}) — \textquotedblleft{}as a precaution, in case\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط} \fa{یک} \fa{چتر} \fa{برداشتم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mahz-e ehtiyât yek chatr bardâshtam.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I took an umbrella in case.
\end{quote}

\emph{Mahz} \textquotedblleft{}pure\textquotedblright{} + \emph{ehtiyât} \textquotedblleft{}caution\textquotedblright{}: purely for caution.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط}} joins two words usually traced to Arabic, \emph{maḥḍ} \textquotedblleft{}pure, mere\textquotedblright{} and \emph{iḥtiyāṭ} \textquotedblleft{}caution\textquotedblright{}, with a Persian ezafe: purely for caution's sake.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{آمادگی} (âmâdegi)}{آمادگی (âmâdegi)}]{\fa{آمادگی} (âmâdegi) — readiness, preparation}

\label{lesson:FA-C397-amadegi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for caution, then the Persian for as a precaution.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{آمادگی}}
\textbf{\fa{آمادگی}} (\emph{âmâdegi}) — \textquotedblleft{}readiness, preparation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{تیم} \fa{ما} \fa{آمادگی} \fa{کامل} \fa{دارد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{tim-e mâ âmâdegi-ye kâmel dârad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our team is fully prepared.
\end{quote}

From \emph{âmâde} \textquotedblleft{}ready\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-gi}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{آمادگی}} is native Persian, built on \emph{âmâde} \textquotedblleft{}ready\textquotedblright{} with the noun suffix \emph{-gi}.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{پیش} \fa{آمدن} (pish âmadan)}{پیش آمدن (pish âmadan)}]{\fa{پیش} \fa{آمدن} (pish âmadan) — to come up, to crop up}

\label{lesson:FA-C397-pish-amadan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for as a precaution, then the Persian for readiness.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{پیش} \fa{آمدن}}
\textbf{\fa{پیش} \fa{آمدن}} (\emph{pish âmadan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to come up, to crop up\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{یک} \fa{مشکل} \fa{کوچک} \fa{پیش} \fa{آمد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{yek moshkel-e kuchek pish âmad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
A small problem came up.
\end{quote}

\emph{Pish} \textquotedblleft{}forward\textquotedblright{} + \emph{âmadan} \textquotedblleft{}to come\textquotedblright{} (present stem \emph{â-}).

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{پیش} \fa{آمدن}} is native Persian, built from \emph{pish} \textquotedblleft{}forward, before\textquotedblright{} + \emph{âmadan} \textquotedblleft{}to come\textquotedblright{}, which EtymDB traces to PIE \emph{g\textsuperscript{w}em-} \textquotedblleft{}to step\textquotedblright{}. A problem steps forward.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{گزینه} (gozine)}{گزینه (gozine)}]{\fa{گزینه} (gozine) — an option, a choice}

\label{lesson:FA-C397-gozine}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for readiness, then the Persian for to come up.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{گزینه}}
\textbf{\fa{گزینه}} (\emph{gozine}) — \textquotedblleft{}an option, a choice\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{ما} \fa{دو} \fa{گزینه} \fa{داریم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mâ do gozine dârim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We have two options.
\end{quote}

From \emph{gozin-}, the present stem of \emph{gozidan} \textquotedblleft{}to choose\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{گزینه}} is a modern native word, built on \emph{gozin-}, the present stem of \emph{gozidan} \textquotedblleft{}to choose\textquotedblright{}: what you can choose.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
